Tapas, Sangria & the Best Paella Ever!
Jun 2020 • Friends
Did you say tapas, sangria, paella? In Ho Chi Minh City? Although international travel may be out of the question it didn’t stop us from getting a taste of Spain at the Ria, downtown Saigon. We had such a fabulous evening full of tasty tapas, yummy sangria and incredible paella! 

Inside the Ria is where the Spanish flair comes to life and its tropical vibes are best paired with a glass of their amazing sangria. We were so ready to dive in to all things tapas, so to start we had the Iberian Ham. Without a doubt, Iberian ham is the best type of ham out there and this dish was no exception. We also had their Ensaladilla, which was a delicious tuna, mayo, potato salad.

In between sips of sangria we had the Patatas Bravas, potatoes with spicy sauce and aioli and the Gambas al Pil Pil, pan-fried garlic prawns. Both phenomenal dishes! 

Last, but certainly not least, we devoured the Seafood Paella. I’ve had my fair share of paella out there and this has to be one of my all time favourites! It was truly an authentic paella that I truly did not want to share! Yum!

For dessert we had the Ria’s homemade Arroz con Leche, a creamy rich rice pudding as well as their homemade creamy cheesecake topped with a delicious berry compote. A perfect way to end a muy deliciosa meal!

If youre in need of a little Spanish pick-me-up this is your place! I already can’t wait to go back! 💃🏼🥘🍷

Welcome find!
Jan 2020 • Couples
My husband and I were in Ho Chi Minh City over Tet which was a wonderful experience although we struggled to find restaurants, near to our hotel, open. Having walked to 2 and found them both closed we were feeling a little despondent! However we, very luckily, found Ria as we wandered and thought the menu looked worth a try......we certainly weren't disappointed! The food was excellent and very authentic, the wine very drinkable and well priced.
After 10 days of fabulous Asian food, it was lovely to find a restaurant offering excellent alternative flavours.
The chef is Spanish and you can certainly tell, we would have been delighted to have this standard of tapas in Europe so very pleasantly surprised to find it in Vietnam.
Thank you so much for an excellent meal!

Needs improvement but ok for drinks
Sep 2018 • Friends
Mediocre at best. Staff needs proper training. It took quite some time for drinks and food despite being empty. Ordered a wide range of dishes and was largely disappointed in both taste and presentation. They also have quite a limited selection on their menu--there are hardly any vegetables available. The quality of food needs to be improved if it hopes to compete with Octo or Tomatito. The only redeeming feature is the large selection of sangrias. Recommend this for drinks but not for eating.
